text: Kevin's housewarming is Sat 14 Nov, new flat in Leyton. He's doing a chilli so bring something veggie for Aoife, she doesn't eat meat anymore.
Deepa's dad had a fall on the stairs, fractured wrist. In plaster for six weeks. She sounded shattered, been driving up to Leicester every other day. Ring her on Sunday to see how she's holding up.
chiara - coeliac, proper strict, not just preference. dont do the pasta thing again
Joseph invited us to his 40th, 3rd of December, at the Crown upstairs room. Lukas says he's after a decent bottle of mezcal, could chip in with Sam for that

So Fiona was telling me her little one, Ruby, has had a temperature since Tuesday and they ended up at out of hours last night. Doctor reckons it's just a virus but she's not sleeping and neither is Fiona. Her husband's away with work till the 12th so she's on her own with both kids. I should drop round some soup or something Thursday, and check in again the next day.
Heather doesn't drink. Sparkling elderflower or ginger beer.
magda op on 22/10 knee. keyhole. text her the day before, then again a couple days after to see how recovery's going

Obi and Mariam are hosting Diwali dinner on 8 Nov, it's their first one in the new house. They asked if I'd bring dessert. Mariam's allergic to tree nuts so nothing with almonds or pistachio. Obi's parents are coming down from Manchester too and his mum is apparently very particular about sweets, so maybe go shop-bought from that place on Green Street rather than risk my own.
Tadhg said his mum's back in hospital, chest infection again. He's flying over to Cork on Friday and probably staying till the weekend after. Message him Friday morning before his flight.
Bought the oat milk. Still need bin bags and the birthday card.
Samir loves really hot food, the hotter the better. Bao can't handle any spice at all. Worth knowing for the dinner.

Rahul's engagement party got called off, he and Priya split up last week. He's gutted. Turns out it had been rocky since the summer but he didn't tell anyone. He's moving back in with his parents for a bit while he sorts out the flat. Don't mention it at football, just take him for a pint sometime soon.
Anjali mentioned her son Arjun broke his collarbone at rugby on Saturday. He's 12, bit of a drama about it apparently but fine. Off sport till after Christmas.
Layla's leaving do is Friday 30 Oct, Bar Nonna from 6. I'm going straight from work.
Note to self — Ines is vegan, Lin is pescatarian, Ioana eats everything but hates coriander. Sofia gluten free. That's the whole book club sorted for the 19th.
Call with Ethan. His partner Kiara is pregnant, due in April! He was a bit nervous telling people. Send them congrats card this week.
wei back to work today after the flu, still coughing. looked rough tbh

Marta's having her housewarming on the 7th of November, said bring a plus one. Her cat Biscuit hides from strangers so don't be offended lol. She loves those little orange chocolates, could bring a box.

Marisol's mum has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. Marisol is trying to overhaul all the family cooking, lots of reading about low-sugar recipes. She seemed a bit overwhelmed. Check in with her next week.

Gabriel's 30th. Saturday 21 November, dinner at Dishoom then drinks after somewhere in Shoreditch. Marisol's organising and asked everyone to keep the evening free. He said the only thing he wants is a new coffee grinder, hint hint, and Marisol confirmed his current one is held together with tape. Could go halves with Yusuf.
Yusuf has been off with his back for a fortnight now. Physio twice a week. He's bored out of his mind at home. Need to pop over with some games for the PS5.
Rafael's daughter Lucia had her tonsils out on Monday. Ice lollies only for days. He said she's actually quite enjoying the attention.
Dinner at Kevin and Aoife's went really well last night. Aoife's lamb was amazing. Should send her a thanks text and ask for the recipe.
deepa doesnt drink coffee, only peppermint tea. also she's off dairy since sept
Chiara invited me to her brother Luca's wedding reception on 12 June next year as her plus one! Need to book the Saturday off and sort a hotel nearby.
Joey - Joseph Okafor from the running club - told me he tore a calf muscle during the half marathon on Sunday. Out for at least a month. Ask him how the scan goes on the 29th.
Lukas messaged to say the barbecue on Sunday is cancelled, rain forecast all weekend. Rescheduling to the 1st of November maybe.
Sam's grandad passed away on Tuesday. Funeral is the 4th, in Galway. He's flying over the day before. I should send flowers to his mum's house and text him that morning.
Fiona is lactose intolerant but fine with hard cheese, she said. Also really into natural wine at the moment, keeps going on about some Georgian orange one.

Spoke to Heather at the school gate. Her husband Tom is having his gallbladder out on 2 Nov and she's worried about managing the kids on her own that week, especially with the youngest just getting over an ear infection. Tom's apparently being very stoic about it but she says he's terrified of hospitals. Offer to do the Wednesday pickup.
Magda and her husband are throwing a joint 35th for their twins on 28/11, it's a 90s theme. Fancy dress obligatory. Ugh.
Obi says his dog Kofi swallowed a sock and needed surgery on Thursday. Vet bill was over a grand. Dog's fine now, back to eating everything in sight.
Mariam is fasting till sunset this week so no lunch plans. Suggested dinner instead, she's free Thursday.
Need to RSVP to Tadhg's housewarming before Friday. Party's the 14th. Ask whether his girlfriend Niamh still can't do shellfish because I was thinking of bringing the prawn thing.
Samir's sister got the all clear after her scan yesterday. Huge relief for the whole family. He said they're doing a big dinner to celebrate on the 25th.
Bao - shellfish allergy, carries an EpiPen. Make sure the restaurant knows before 9 Oct... actually that's already gone. For next time.

Rahul is having a really hard time at the moment. His dad's dementia is getting worse and his mum can't cope alone, so he's going part time from January to help. He didn't want to talk about it much. Just keep inviting him to things even if he says no. Maybe ask him round for dinner the week after next.
Anjali's birthday drinks moved from 17th to the 24th because half the group had covid. She's into gin, specifically anything pink apparently.

Okay voice note. Layla's son Adam has chickenpox, so she's out of the Halloween party on the 31st. She was devastated, she'd made the whole costume. She's also worried about her mum catching it, mum's on chemo. Drop off a care package sometime this weekend, and remember to ask about her mum's next round, which I think is the 6th.

Ines hosting a Sunday roast on 15 Nov, nut roast for her obviously. Lin bringing pudding. Me on wine. Ines prefers red, Lin only drinks white. Ioana might come if her shift finishes in time, she's been doing nights at the hospital since September and is knackered. Sofia can't make it, her nan's poorly.
Ioana said her boyfriend Mihai has started a keto diet and is impossible to cook for. Also she wants to do a cocktail night at hers some time in Dec.
Sofia's first day back at work after her surgery is Monday 26th. She's nervous about the commute. Text her good luck the night before and ask how it went the next day.

Ethan's having his stag do in Lisbon, 6th to 9th of March. Need to pay the deposit by the end of the month, Kevin's collecting. Ethan's brother Ryan is best man and has apparently planned a seafood boat trip, which is a problem because Ethan's allergic to prawns. Kevin's going to have a word.
kiara mum unwell again, kidney stuff. kiara staying w her for a bit
Wei was asking if I'd come to his son's birthday party on the 1st, he's turning 6. Dinosaur theme. Could get him that T-rex excavation kit.
Marta's got really into fermenting stuff, kimchi, kombucha, the lot. Her whole kitchen smells of it.
Marisol and Gabriel invited me for paella at theirs on Saturday. He's doing the cooking, she's doing sangria. I said I'd bring bread and olives.
Yusuf's daughter Hana has a broken arm from the trampoline park. Cast comes off 18 December. Yusuf feels terrible because he took her.
Rafael - huge Arsenal fan, likes craft IPAs, hates anything with mushrooms. Wife is Elena.
dentist 11/11 9.20. then pharmacy for the prescription the same morning

Joseph's mum is having a hip replacement on the 5th of November. He's taking the week after off to look after her. Remember to text him the day of the op and maybe drop off a lasagne a few days later.
Aoife told me today she's been having panic attacks since the accident. Started CBT last week. She's finding it really hard but said talking helps. I must call her more often, even just ten minutes.
Kevin is doing dry January this year, said he's hoping to keep it going into Feb.

Heather's mother-in-law's 70th is on 4 Dec, big lunch at a hotel. She's stressed about the seating plan and catering for her mother-in-law's allergies, which are... everything basically. Gluten, eggs, soy.
Got invited to the neighbours' bonfire night thing, 5th of Nov. Bring sparklers and something to drink.
Lin's dad's heart scan came back fine. She was so relieved. Lin also said she's finally going ahead with the dinner party she keeps talking about, 20th of Nov probably.
Samir, Deepa and Rahul are all coming to mine for curry on the 13th. Deepa can't eat onion or garlic, Samir wants it hot, Rahul's easy. I'm doing two separate pots.
Chiara's little boy Matteo is starting nursery on 2 Nov. She's more anxious than he is. Ask her afterwards how drop off went.
Gabe aka Gabriel said his partner Tomás got the head chef job at that new place in Hackney! Starts 16 Nov. Opening night party is the week after. Send congrats and book a table for when it opens.
Mrs Brennan next door has the shingles, really painful apparently. Her daughter's coming to stay from Thursday. Ask if she needs anything from the shops.
